provenance.scope: three single cloud runs; 0.8B/2B serial observer, 4B background observer; first use penalty estimated from cold minus median warm prefill; availability lower bounds, not production distributions
provenance.validation: all other cases; no validation loss is used in fitting

profiles.evidence: empirical startup/quoted rental; effective serving parameters fitted only on hot-single and two hot policy workloads; region-specific serving variation unmeasured
profiles.source: native-cloud-observations-2026-10-11; model/runtime/controller hashes retained in dataset provenance
